inlines.text: 蚂蚁集团与 vLLM 社区开源 Humming，这是一个面向量化推理的通用高性能内核库。Humming 具备以下特性：
广泛的设备支持
：支持从 Turing 起的 NVIDIA GPU 架构，以及平头哥镇岳 810E 等 CUDA 兼容设备。
全面的量化支持
：统一架构支持稠密与 MoE 工作负载下权重和激活格式的多种组合，覆盖广泛的整数与浮点类型、位宽及缩放方案。
强劲的执行性能
：在许多代表性工作负载上显著优于 vLLM Marlin、FlashInfer 和 DeepGEMM 的现有实现。

blocks.text: 随着模型和推理工作负载的增长，内存容量、内存带宽和计算成本日益制约部署。这在 MoE 模型中尤为明显：每个 token 仅激活一部分专家，但全部权重仍需存储。例如 DeepSeek-V3 拥有 6710 亿参数，每个 token 激活 370 亿参数。量化通过降低权重和激活的精度来减少内存占用和数据搬运，同时也能提升计算效率。

blocks.text: 三种配置用于描述内核：

inlines.text: 三种配置用于描述内核：
层配置
描述张量形状、数据类型、量化参数和目标架构。
计算配置
指定 GEMM 类型和计算选项，例如批次不变性和输入缩放布局。
调优配置
选择瓦片形状、流水线阶段数、warp 特化、内存访问和 MMA 指令。它还控制并发与调度；TMA 可以按张量进行配置。

blocks.text: 默认情况下，Humming 使用针对具体设备的启发式规则来选择调优配置。它可以为不同范围的输入尺寸准备不同的配置，并在运行时分派到合适的内核。

blocks.text: 跨格式与架构的共享 CUDA 组件

inlines.text: 跨格式与架构的共享 CUDA 组件

blocks.text: 在 CUDA 层面，Humming 将任务调度、数据移动、反量化与缩放、Tensor Core 计算以及输出处理组织为可复用的组件。它提供标准流水线、warp 特化流水线和专用 UMMA 流水线。这些流水线共享兼容的组件，同时采用各自执行策略所需的数据流和同步方式。

inlines.text: 在 CUDA 层面，Humming 将任务调度、数据移动、反量化与缩放、Tensor Core 计算以及输出处理组织为可复用的组件。它提供标准流水线、warp 特化流水线和专用 UMMA 流水线。这些流水线共享兼容的组件，同时采用各自执行策略所需的数据流和同步方式。

blocks.text: 每组组件处理不同的变化来源：

inlines.text: 每组组件处理不同的变化来源：
数值处理负责量化格式。
解码和算术组件处理位宽、整数或浮点表示、缩放因子和零点。反量化与缩放被集成到内核的计算中。
内存与计算后端负责 GPU 架构。
Humming 为目标架构选择数据移动和 Tensor Core 实现，并在支持时使用异步拷贝、TMA 和多播。
任务映射与调度负责稠密和 MoE 工作负载。
每种 GEMM 类型使用相应的调度逻辑。缩放和偏置加法也可以融合到输出阶段。

blocks.text: JIT 编译会根据三种配置组合这些组件，并消除未使用的实现分支。因此，可以通过扩展相关组件来支持新的格式或架构。对共享组件的改进会使兼容的配置受益，从而减少对各自专用内核的重复开发和维护。

blocks.text: 这个 CUDA 实现轻量且避免了重量级内核框架依赖，同时保持 JIT 编译快速。在我们于配备 CUDA 13.4 的 H200 服务器上进行的单 W4A16 内核编译测试中，在禁用编译缓存的情况下，编译时间从 CUTLASS 配合 NVCC 的 23.35 秒降至 Humming 配合 NVCC 的 1.82 秒或配合 NVRTC 的 1.88 秒。这降低了为新工作负载准备内核的成本，并使迭代调优更加实用。Humming 还会在模型预热期间并行编译内核。在我们的测试中，编译并加载覆盖单层 GEMM 所有受支持 M 大小的内核仅需约 2–4 秒，使得在推理前准备多个专用内核变得切实可行。

inlines.text: 基于设备参数的性能调优

blocks.text: Humming 利用 GEMM 配置和设备参数对内核进行深度优化。量化格式、矩阵形状、GPU 指令支持、SM 数量、共享内存和寄存器资源都会影响执行选择，从而将低位存储的优势转化为实际的推理性能。

inlines.text: Humming 利用 GEMM 配置和设备参数对内核进行深度优化。量化格式、矩阵形状、GPU 指令支持、SM 数量、共享内存和寄存器资源都会影响执行选择，从而将低位存储的优势转化为实际的推理性能。

blocks.text: 在现有 GPU 上实现高效的 W4A8-MXFP4 推理。Blackwell 之前的架构缺乏原生 MXFP4 Tensor Core 支持，而传统的 W4A8-MXFP4 内核在较大 M 时可能受限于反量化和缩放开销。Humming 通过快速的 MXFP4 到 INT8/FP8 反量化路径解决了这一问题，该路径在内核内将 MXFP4 权重转换为受支持的计算格式。在此设置下，该路径在较小 M 时显著优于传统 W4A8 实现，在较大 M 时接近 W8A8 性能。因此，H200 等 GPU 可以运行高性能 W4A8-MXFP4 内核，同时保留 4 位权重的存储优势。

blocks.text: WnA16

inlines.text: WnA16

blocks.text: WnA16 是量化推理中最通用、应用最广泛的方法之一。它将低比特权重与 FP16/BF16 激活相结合，在减少权重存储和内存流量的同时，利用广泛可用的 16 位计算能力。这使其适用于许多 GPU 世代和模型部署场景。W4A16 系列尤其受到社区关注，也是 Humming 优化工作的重点。

blocks.text: W8A8 / W4A8 / W4A4

inlines.text: W8A8 / W4A8 / W4A4

blocks.text: 在 Hopper 上，采用块级缩放的 FP8 W8A8 已成为高性能量化推理的主流方法。Humming 通过协同优化数据移动、缩放和专家调度，进一步改进这一成熟的计算路径。下方左列展示了 H20 和 H200 上的 W8A8 结果。在小批量和中等批量下，Humming 分别达到 DeepGEMM Contiguous 约 2.6 倍和 2.5 倍的性能，Indexed 和 Grouped 两种布局均具有竞争力。

inlines.text: 在 Hopper 上，采用块级缩放的 FP8 W8A8 已成为高性能量化推理的主流方法。Humming 通过协同优化数据移动、缩放和专家调度，进一步改进这一成熟的计算路径。下方左列展示了 H20 和 H200 上的 W8A8 结果。在小批量和中等批量下，Humming 分别达到 DeepGEMM Contiguous 约 2.6 倍和 2.5 倍的性能，Indexed 和 Grouped 两种布局均具有竞争力。

blocks.text: 随着更多模型采用原生 MXFP4 权重量化，将更小的权重占用转化为实际推理收益变得越来越有价值。Humming 通过高效的 W4A8 路径解决这一问题：在加载 MXFP4 权重时快速反量化，并使用 FP8 Tensor Core 进行计算，从而在 Hopper 上实现高效的 W4A8-MXFP4 执行。上方右列以 DeepGEMM W8A8 为基线。在小批量和中等批量下，Humming 的 W4A8 在 H20 上达到约 4.2 倍基线性能，在 H200 上达到 4.5 倍，同时也大幅优于同一图中 Humming 的 W8A8 结果。权重流量的减少转化为更低的 GEMM 延迟。FlashInfer CUTLASS W4A8 也是基于 Humming 方法的实现，而 Humming 当前的实现在此处展示的基准测试中取得更好性能。

blocks.text: Background

inlines.text: Background

blocks.text: As models and inference workloads grow, memory capacity, memory bandwidth, and compute costs increasingly constrain deployment. This is especially apparent in MoE models: each token activates only a subset of experts, but the full set of weights still needs to be stored. DeepSeek-V3, for example, has 671 billion parameters, with 37 billion activated per token. Quantization lowers the precision of weights and activations to reduce memory usage and data movement, and can also improve compute efficiency.

blocks.text: Quantization requirements vary across models and GPU generations. Common configurations include WNA16, W8A8, W4A8, and W4A4, where W and A specify weight and activation bit widths, and N denotes a variable weight bit width. Even at the same precision, schemes such as INT4 and NVFP4 differ in numeric format and scaling. Scaling granularity, scale representation, group size, and symmetric or asymmetric quantization further expand the configuration space.

blocks.text: Humming’s unified architecture makes it straightforward to tune execution parameters and select pipelines for different workloads. blocks.text: Shared CUDA Components Across Formats and Architectures

inlines.text: Shared CUDA Components Across Formats and Architectures

blocks.text: At the CUDA level, Humming organizes task scheduling, data movement, dequantization and scaling, Tensor Core computation, and output processing into reusable components. It provides standard, warp-specialized, and dedicated UMMA pipelines. These pipelines share compatible components while using the dataflow and synchronization required by each execution strategy.

inlines.text: At the CUDA level, Humming organizes task scheduling, data movement, dequantization and scaling, Tensor Core computation, and output processing into reusable components. It provides standard, warp-specialized, and dedicated UMMA pipelines. These pipelines share compatible components while using the dataflow and synchronization required by each execution strategy.

blocks.text: Each group of components handles a different source of variation:

inlines.text: Each group of components handles a different source of variation:
Numeric processing handles quantization formats.
Decoding and arithmetic components account for bit width, integer or floating-point representation, scales, and zero points. Dequantization and scaling are integrated into the kernel's computation.
Memory and compute backends handle GPU architectures.
Humming selects data movement and Tensor Core implementations for the target architecture, using asynchronous copies, TMA, and multicast where supported.
Task mapping and scheduling handle dense and MoE workloads.
Each GEMM type uses the appropriate scheduling logic. Scaling and bias addition can also be fused into the output stage.

blocks.text: JIT compilation combines these components according to the three configurations and eliminates unused implementation branches. A new format or architecture can therefore be supported by extending the relevant components. Improvements to a shared component benefit compatible configurations, reducing the duplicated development and maintenance of separate specialized kernels.

blocks.text: This CUDA implementation is lightweight and avoids heavyweight kernel framework dependencies, keeping JIT compilation fast as well. In our single W4A16 kernel compilation test on an H200 server with CUDA 13.4, compilation time dropped from 23.35 seconds for CUTLASS with NVCC to 1.82 seconds for Humming with NVCC or 1.88 seconds with NVRTC, with compilation caches disabled. This reduces the cost of preparing kernels for new workloads and makes iterative tuning more practical. Humming also compiles kernels in parallel during model warmup. In our tests, compiling and loading the kernels covering all supported M sizes for a single layer's GEMM takes only about 2–4 seconds, making it practical to prepare multiple specialized kernels before inference.

inlines.text: Performance Tuning Based on Device Parameters

blocks.text: Humming deeply optimizes kernels using both the GEMM configuration and device parameters. Quantization formats, matrix shapes, GPU instruction support, SM count, shared memory, and register resources all inform execution choices, turning the benefits of low-bit storage into practical inference performance.

blocks.text: Efficient W4A8-MXFP4 inference on existing GPUs. Architectures before Blackwell lack native MXFP4 Tensor Core support, and conventional W4A8-MXFP4 kernels can be limited by dequantization and scaling overhead at larger M. Humming addresses this with a fast MXFP4-to-INT8/FP8 dequantization path that converts MXFP4 weights into a supported compute format within the kernel. In this setting, the path substantially outperforms conventional W4A8 implementations at small M and approaches W8A8 performance at large M. GPUs such as H200 can therefore run high-performance W4A8-MXFP4 kernels while retaining the storage benefits of 4-bit weights.

blocks.text: WnA16

inlines.text: WnA16

blocks.text: WnA16 is one of the most versatile and widely used approaches to quantized inference. It combines low-bit weights with FP16/BF16 activations, reducing weight storage and memory traffic while making use of widely available 16-bit compute capabilities. This makes it suitable for many GPU generations and model deployment scenarios. The W4A16 family has attracted particular interest from the community and is a major focus of Humming's optimization work.

inlines.text: End-to-End Inference Performance

blocks.text: Humming's W4A8 gains extend to model serving. In our DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash test on eight H20 GPUs with TP=8, keeping the model's MXFP4 weights unchanged and switching MoE execution from Marlin W4A16 (BF16 activations) to Humming W4A8 (tokenwise FP8 activations) improves end-to-end throughput by approximately 14%–43% and reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by approximately 25%–32%. The throughput advantage grows with concurrency: at concurrency 64, output throughput rises from 442.37 to 633.94 tokens/s, while mean time per output token (TPOT) falls by approximately 31%.

Humming uses a CUDA compiler to generate kernels on demand. If no CUDA compiler is available on the system, choose one of the following installation options to include the compilation dependencies for your environment's CUDA major version:

Humming itself is extremely lightweight, with simple dependencies and a wheel package of only about 500 KB. On-demand compilation avoids bundling a large collection of precompiled kernels. Selecting Activation Types

inlines.text: Selecting Activation Types

blocks.text: By default, Humming uses the activation type specified in the checkpoint and adapts execution to the device. If the GPU does not support that compute type, Humming falls back to a supported higher-precision type. For example, devices without native MXFP4 support can automatically use FP8, BF16, or FP16 compute paths, allowing the same quantized checkpoint to run across GPU generations.

blocks.text: Adding Autotune

inlines.text: Adding Autotune

blocks.text: With targeted tuning, Humming can already achieve state-of-the-art performance in most scenarios. However, the wide range of model shapes, quantization configurations, and device resources makes it difficult for heuristics to select the optimal configuration in every case.

blocks.text: Humming therefore plans to introduce autotune, benchmarking candidate configurations on the target device to find better execution parameters for each workload. Autotune will complement existing heuristics, reducing manual configuration search and helping more workloads approach the kernels' best achievable performance.

blocks.text: Deeper Integration with Inference Frameworks

inlines.text: Deeper Integration with Inference Frameworks

blocks.text: Humming will continue deepening its integration with inference frameworks such as vLLM, expanding support across quantized model loading, backend selection, parallel inference, runtime scheduling, and device adaptation. We aim to make more quantization methods work with the full range of framework capabilities, including optimizations such as quantized All-to-All (A2A) communication for expert parallelism (EP). These efforts will make high-performance quantized kernels easier to use across diverse deployment scenarios and help translate kernel performance gains into end-to-end inference benefits.
